title: B2B Social Post Factory Writer
description: A multi-agent AI orchestration pipeline that produces LinkedIn content for B2B founders and company pages.
features: Staged relay from ingest through planning to writers, with stop and resume controls
One system prompt per pipeline stage
Multi-file ingest with PDF, DOCX, and PPTX extraction
Brand DNA lock applied to image prompts
DOCX export of generated content

title: Scout-Jevhire
description: Scout-Jevhire finds real open roles on LinkedIn and filters out the noise. Point it at a job title; it scouts recent posts, uses Jev to keep only true employer and recruiter hiring ads, and surfaces what teams need to act on hiring opportunities faster.
features: Searches two time windows and removes duplicates across them
Local keyword and role pre-filter
Jev probability check with a 0.75 keep threshold
Email and apply links extracted with regex rather than GPT
Strict pydantic schemas for extracted fields

title: GTM-Agent
description: Public-signal first-customer finder for GTM. Given a product URL, it researches dated demand signals (ideally ≤30 days), scores prospects on pain/fit/timing, verifies contact routes, and generates a Markdown/CSV report with draft openers. Privacy-first: public sources only; no enrichment or auto-send.
features: Weighted 0-100 prospect score across pain, fit, timing, reachability, and evidence
Validation that rejects guessed contact URLs
Stable prospect IDs from canonicalized URLs
Markdown, CSV, and HTML report exports
Local history with keep, maybe, and reject feedback

title: Virtual Try-On
description: Multi-model AI virtual try-on benchmark: run the same person, apparel, and prompt across OpenAI + OpenRouter image models, then compare visual quality, latency, and per-model cost side by side.
features: Registry of 5 OpenAI and 6 OpenRouter image models
Concurrent runs with error handling per model
Latency recorded for each model call
Cost calculation across three pricing modes
Editable positive and negative prompts
